notes: Permanent account-owned systems only; excludes workshop, bots, and loadout surfaces.
Permanent account-owned systems only; excludes workshop, bots, and loadout surfaces.
Adds gem-respeccable systems on top of account baseline; excludes loadout-only cards/modules.
Current IDS preset with active loadout applied.
Max progression projects workshop rows to max_level while preserving current permanent state and loadout.
Perks can be materialized in this state when supplied via input/perks.json or --perks.
EP export compare uses run-situation policy: offense surfaces use Tourney loadout with perks off; non-offense surfaces use Farming by default and follow the selected engine perk state.
EP export max progression implies max workshop and farming-side perk application beyond the current IDS/loadout-present package state.
The current package can store externally selected perk presets from input/perks.json, compile perk stat inputs, and resolve supported perk contributors into final stats.
Perk selections are not parsed from IDS itself; they must be supplied explicitly when a run state needs them.
Perk application is controlled at engine scope via --perk-state auto|on|off; perks are either materialized for the run or fully disabled.
When values do not match and EP uses unsupported stage facets, compare status is stage_scope_mismatch rather than a hard formula mismatch.
Max Recovery EP export is treated as a non-comparable health-at-cap surface, not a multiplier.

burn_down.note: calculator_scope excludes preserved-only lab/admin/runtime rows and grouping/admin surfaces that are intentionally outside the current calculator publish surface.

compare_package_value_provenance.note: ep_oracle_compare package_value may differ from statbook.json when compare_preset differs from the default output preset.

notes: Active unmapped inputs are live calculator inputs without a KB destination contract in the current package.
Resolved rows with schema.unit=unknown are publishable bridges, but not convergence-grade clean contracts.
ambiguous_relic_semantic_hints lists KB registry rows that still admit multiple semantic interpretations and may need future wiki-backed tightening.
